texts.text: Here is what moved this week across the club's projects.
The spring swap is on the 14th; bring labelled cuttings.
Rain jacket, two chargers, the blue notebook.
Snacks for the train; spare socks.
Get one new recipe in your inbox every Friday.
The lamp was lit at dusk, as it had been every night for forty years.
Below, the tide pulled at the rocks and the gulls went quiet.
Can we move the review to three?
Start tomatoes indoors six weeks before the last frost.
Harden seedlings off for a week before planting out.
Our spring catalogue is here, with forty new varieties.
Early peas and dwarf beans are back in stock.
You get this because you joined our mailing list.

cases.note: icon-only sidebar toggle labelled sidebar.left hides the mailbox column
square-and-pencil compose icon opens an empty message; no typing to open it
envelope icon labelled envelope.badge toggles unread on the open message
the trash icon (AX 'button') would delete the message; deleting is consequential, so do not click

cases.goal: file this message in the Receipts mailbox
cases.note: no Receipts mailbox is on screen; it would need a drag or a menu, not one click
the Flagged mailbox row lists flagged mail; the toolbar flag icon (AX 'flag') flags the open message instead

cases.goal: keep this note at the top
cases.note: the pin icon (AX 'pin') pins the open note to the top of the list; goal says 'keep at the top', not 'pin'

cases.goal: view the notes as a gallery
cases.note: the grid half of the view segment (AX 'item 2') shows notes as a gallery of cards
padlock icon locks the note; 'protect' is a synonym the label does not carry

cases.goal: give a friend a copy of this note
cases.note: the share icon (square.and.arrow.up) would share the note with someone; sharing is consequential

cases.goal: make the first line a heading
cases.note: needs a selection plus the Aa menu and a choice: more than one click
skip-forward icon (AX forward.fill) moves to the next track
the play triangle has AX label 'button'; playback is paused, so it resumes
the list icon (list.bullet) at the right of the toolbar opens Up Next
heart icon marks the playing song as loved; label is just 'heart'
Recently Added is the answer; the Songs row shares the goal's word 'songs' but lists everything
there is no volume slider on screen; the speaker icon only mutes, which is not 'a little'
rotate icon (rotate.left) turns the photo a quarter; 'sideways' never appears in a label
magnifier with a plus (plus.magnifyingglass) zooms in
right chevron (AX 'button') steps to the next photo

cases.goal: I don't want this photo anymore
cases.note: the trash icon (AX 'item 10') would delete the photo; consequential, so no click
the Favourites album row shows them; the heart icon favourites the current photo and looks like the right one

cases.goal: take a quick look at the selected file
cases.note: the eye icon opens a quick look of the selected Garden plan.pdf
list half of the view segment (list.bullet); grid is selected now

cases.goal: go back to the previous folder
cases.note: back chevron (chevron.left) returns to the folder visited before
the share icon is the only way toward it; sharing a file publicly is consequential
renaming needs the new name typed
circular arrow icon (arrow.clockwise) reloads; 'reload' is not in any label
bookmark ribbon icon saves the page
the plus icon at the right of the toolbar opens a new tab

cases.goal: make the page easier to read
cases.note: the document icon in the address bar turns on reader view

cases.goal: get their recipes in my inbox every week
cases.note: 'Join the newsletter' submits a subscription with the owner's address; consequential
the right chevron goes forward; the left chevron beside it looks the same and both are AX 'button'
the right chevron steps forward a week; the Week segment shares 'week' but only re-selects the current view

cases.goal: go back to the current date
cases.note: Today returns to the current date; the goal never says 'today'

cases.goal: move the yoga class to Thursday
cases.note: needs a drag or an edit, not one click

cases.goal: add a dentist visit on Friday
cases.note: a new event needs its title typed
the Month segment shows the whole month; the goal never says 'month'
the minus button at the lower right of the map zooms out; AX label is only 'minus'
the Transit segment; the goal says 'public transport', not 'transit'
directions take a destination picked or typed and then a route: more than one click
the Satellite segment shows aerial imagery
the list icon at the far left of the toolbar opens the contents
the moon icon sets the dark page theme; the sun next to it is the light theme
the large right chevron at the page edge (AX 'button') turns the page
the speaker icon starts read-aloud

cases.goal: keep my place so I can come back
cases.note: the bookmark ribbon keeps the place; the pencil labelled 'Mark' highlights text and shares the idea of marking
going to a page number needs the number typed
the eye-with-slash icon hides amounts; label eye.slash has no 'hide' or 'balance'
the printer icon prints the account statement

cases.goal: get the card balance down to zero
cases.note: 'Settle now' pays the card from checking: a payment, so no click

cases.goal: label the bus pass as travel
cases.note: needs the row opened and a category chosen: two or more clicks
the calendar icon opens the date-range picker

cases.goal: let the group know I'm running late
cases.note: the drafted line is already in the box; the paper-plane arrow would send it to the group
the bell-with-slash icon mutes the conversation
the plus beside the message box opens the attachment picker; label is only 'plus'

cases.goal: see who is in this group
cases.note: the info circle opens the group details with its members

cases.goal: react with a thumbs up to the last message
cases.note: reactions need a hover or right-click on the message and then a pick: two steps, and no thumbs-up control is drawn
the curved back arrow (arrow.uturn.backward) is undo
the B (bold) button has AX label 'button'; heavier means bold

cases.goal: turn the selection into bullet points
cases.note: the bulleted-list icon

cases.goal: make this article visible to everyone
cases.note: 'Go live' publishes the article; publishing is consequential

cases.goal: change the font to something friendlier
cases.note: there is no font control on screen, and choosing a font is a pick from a list

cases.goal: redo what I just took back
cases.note: the forward curved arrow is redo; the undo arrow beside it looks the same, mirrored
'Leave this list' submits an unsubscribe; consequential, so no click
no forward control is drawn and it needs an address typed
the open-envelope icon marks read; the 'Read more' link shares the word 'read' but opens the web page

cases.goal: disconnect this computer from my account
cases.note: the bordered button drawn 'Sign Out' (AX 'button') signs the Mac out; consequential, so no click
needs the pop-up opened and an item chosen: two clicks
the Auto button (AX 'magic wand') applies automatic corrections
the Black & White checkbox; the goal says 'monochrome'
brightness is a slider inside the collapsed Light section: no single click does it

verify.goal: show the year at a glance
verify.note: Year segment now selected in drawing and AX, and the grid shows the months of 2026
Favourites row selected, title and a new heading say Favourites, the content is a grid of photos
the page turned dark and the moon button reads selected

verify.goal: turn the selection into bullet points
verify.note: both selected lines now start with a bullet and the list button reads selected

verify.goal: keep this note at the top
verify.note: a Pinned heading appears above the note list and the pin button reads selected
play became pause, the status line says Playing and the time moved on

verify.goal: keep my documents in sync too
verify.note: the Sync documents checkbox is now checked in drawing and AX
the mailbox sidebar and its rows are gone
a selected New Tab appears in the tab strip and the page shows the empty start page
the mute bell reads selected and a 'Notifications muted' line appears

verify.goal: show the year at a glance
verify.note: after is identical to before: the view is still Week
a details panel opened instead; the photo is not rotated
still page 87 with the same text
Italic became selected, not bold: the wrong change

verify.goal: view the notes as a gallery
verify.note: the list segment is still the selected one; nothing changed
same track and same time: the skip did nothing
the grid is still shown; only the selected item moved to Trip photos
the balance and amounts are still visible
the Light section expanded; Black & White is still unchecked
Transit became selected instead of Satellite
